booking_notice.instructions: Choose how much advance notice to require for new meetings based on the next two workdays. Keep the owner minimum for light or meeting-heavy days. Extend it when focus work or deadlines need protection. Never shorten the owner minimum. Use only the aggregate minutes supplied.

weekly_adjustment.instructions: Which one adjustment best protects the owner during this unusually busy week? Choose from the aggregate workload only. This is a private suggestion for review, not an automatic calendar change.

criteria.cluster_meetings: Group new calls onto days that already contain meetings.
criteria.protect_focus: Keep long uninterrupted work blocks on the quieter days.
criteria.protect_deadline: Reduce new meetings before an upcoming deadline.
